# 小光Humanizer

> Chinese and English editing skill for removing AI writing habits while preserving meaning and voice.

## Agent entrypoints

- [Install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/main/INSTALL.md): Start here when asked to learn or install the skill. Persist the complete package and verify host discovery.
- [Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/main/agent.json): Skill identity, version, capabilities, and relative loading paths.
- [Instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/main/SKILL.md): Read before editing.
- [Integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/main/docs/agent-integration.md): Installation and task conventions.

## Distribution

- [Native skill package](https://github.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/releases/latest/download/xiaoguang-humanizer-skill.zip): Import into a skill manager or install in a supported skill directory.
- [Runtime directory](https://github.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/tree/main/plugins/xiaoguang-humanizer/skills/xiaoguang-humanizer): Install this complete directory, not a summary of its contents.
- [Plugin marketplace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/main/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json): ChatGPT/Codex plugin discovery.
- [Platform guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/main/docs/platform-guide.md): Native installation, persistence scope, and invocation for each supported route.

Legacy files under prompts/ are text exports, not installed skills. Do not use them as a silent fallback for an installation request.

## Editing references

- [Shared patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/main/references/anti-patterns.md): Load for all editing tasks.
- [Chinese](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/main/references/chinese.md): Load for Chinese output.
- [English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/main/references/english.md): Load for English output.

## Maintenance

- [Evaluation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/main/references/evaluation-cases.md): Behavioral regression cases.
- [Sources](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArB1t3r/xiaoguang-humanizer/main/references/sources.md): Attribution and design decisions.
